name: InterContinental Chicago Magnificent Mile
insider_take: The InterContinental Chicago Magnificent Mile occupies a stunning 1929 Art Deco masterpiece that once served as the exclusive Medinah Athletic Club, complete with a rooftop putting green and Olympic-sized swimming pool that still exist today.
whats_special: This historic tower features the original Junior Olympic swimming pool on the 14th floor - one of the highest pools in any downtown Chicago hotel. The building's Renaissance Revival architecture includes hand-painted ceilings, marble columns, and intricate mosaic work that transport guests back to the Roaring Twenties. Its prime Magnificent Mile location puts you steps from over 460 stores and just two blocks from Navy Pier.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 15-42 for spectacular views of Lake Michigan and the Chicago River, and don't miss the hotel's historic King Arthur's Court - a medieval-themed banquet hall that's been a Chicago landmark since 1929.
dont_miss: Take a dip in that legendary 14th-floor pool with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city, explore the original hand-carved stone gargoyles throughout the building, and grab drinks at the sophisticated Michael Jordan's Steak House located right in the hotel.
pros: Prime Magnificent Mile location with direct shopping access
Luxurious rooms with panoramic city and lake views
Award-winning Alinea restaurant and rooftop dining
Premium fitness center and spa facilities
